title: Manga Server Overview
description: Operational overview for HTTP, downloads, library updates, media work, resilience, cache, runtime pressure, and alert posture.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (job, le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))) or on() vector(0)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (job, le, http_route, http_request_method) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (job, le, http_route, http_request_method) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])))
sum by (source) (rate(manga_server_download_page_bytes_total{job="$job", source=~"$source"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() vector(0)

sum by (source) (rate(manga_server_download_page_fetch_cache_total{job="$job", source=~"$source", result="hit"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (source) (rate(manga_server_download_page_fetch_cache_total{job="$job", source=~"$source"}[$__rate_interval])), 0.001)
sum by (source) (manga_server_downloads_active{job="$job", source=~"$source"}) or on() vector(0)

(sum by (source) (rate(manga_server_download_archive_bytes_sum{job="$job", source=~"$source"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (source) (rate(manga_server_download_archive_bytes_count{job="$job", source=~"$source"}[$__rate_interval])), 0.001)) or on() vector(0)

(sum by (stage, outcome) (rate(manga_server_media_proxy_stage_duration_seconds_sum{job="$job", source=~"$source"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (stage, outcome) (rate(manga_server_media_proxy_stage_duration_seconds_count{job="$job", source=~"$source"}[$__rate_interval])), 0.001)) or on() vector(0)

(sum by (outcome) (rate(manga_server_search_cache_warm_duration_seconds_sum{job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (outcome) (rate(manga_server_search_cache_warm_duration_seconds_count{job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])), 0.001)) or on() vector(0)
sum by (trigger, outcome) (rate(manga_server_archive_index_builds_total{job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() vector(0)

(sum by (trigger) (rate(manga_server_archive_index_build_duration_seconds_sum{job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (trigger) (rate(manga_server_archive_index_build_duration_seconds_count{job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])), 0.001)) or on() vector(0)
